answer_1.quote: models are required to predict event types, denoted as C, for each trigger, without relying on pre-defined ontologies. Furthermore, models must provide fine-grained definitions D = {(t, d) | t ∈ C} for each event type.

answer_2.quote: SEOE leverages large language models (LLMs) as automatic evaluation agents to compute a semantic F1-score.

answer_3.quote: we utilize LLMs as the automatic semantic evaluation agent.

answer_4.quote: we invite 3 professional event annotators to evaluate 200 event-containing documents (791 prediction-gold event pairs in total).
answer_4.guideline: These annotators are given the same prompts as those given to LLMs.
